name: 37419 · Chattanooga, TN
findings: ZIP 37419 (Chattanooga) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37419 (Chattanooga) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37419 (Chattanooga) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
